body: Checked the complete merge path. `Graph::merge_nodes` already ends with `st.forward(keep, discard)`, and `State::forward` clears all cached closures after forwarding identity and folding adjacency, children and classes. There is no selected role read between the journal merge event and that invalidation. The existing `transitive_cache_keeps_hierarchy_inverse_paths_and_rebuilds_after_equality` regression warms the cache under causal capture, merges, reads again, and checks the retained path and merge cause for named, inverse and inverse-partner roles. It passed again in the current library run (811 passed, one existing report-only test ignored). This finding is a false positive; a second clear would duplicate the existing invalidation.
